meta.name: zai-tts
meta.description: Text-to-speech conversion using GLM-TTS service via the `uvx zai-tts` command for generating audio from text. Use when (1) User requests audio/voice output with the "tts" trigger or keyword. (2) Content needs to be spoken rather than read (multitasking, accessibility, podcast, driving, cooking). (3) Using pre-cloned voices for speech.

copy.tagline: 将文字转为自然语音，支持多种场景播放
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要将文字内容转为语音以便在开车、做饭时收听
copy.tagline_en: Convert text to natural speech for listening on the go
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn text into speech for listening while driving or cooking

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以将文字转为语音，生成 WAV 音频文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求输出语音或提到“tts”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 请把这段话转成语音：你好，世界。
用 Chloe 的声音朗读这段文字。
把文件中的内容读出来。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can convert text to speech and generate WAV audio files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests audio output or mentions keywords like "tts".

say_en.text: Please convert this text to speech: Hello, world.
Read this text using Chloe's voice.
Read the content from this file.
